282:t_1:87.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's enough, Chamber. This is educational guidance.」

282:t_1:88.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Query. What is educational guidance?」

282:t_1:89.en:
$$スズネ$$
「W-well, it's originally a judo term for a warning short of a penalty, but here it means conduct judged to violate the ethics code for minors...」

282:t_1:92.en:
$$アルト$$
「A-anyway! Now that we've calmed down, let's go over the situation so far!」

282:t_1:93.en:
$$チコ$$
「What bothers me most is that woman we saw in that mysterious space, right?」

282:t_1:94.en:
$$ボス$$
「No need to worry. She's on our side.」

282:t_1:95.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What's your basis for that? 'Because she's beautiful' is no reason at all.」

282:t_1:97.en:
$$クラン$$
「Don't just go silent on us!」

282:t_1:98.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「But I agree with $$ボス$$.」

282:t_1:100.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Beauty aside, I can't believe that person is an enemy.」

282:t_1:105.en:
$n
「...True, my blood-stained eyes tell me I'm not unconnected to that woman...」

282:t_1:106.en:
$n
「But like everyone else, I... didn't sense any hostility from her.」

282:t_1:107.en:
$$チコ$$
「So your gut says she's in the clear... I have no objections either.」

282:t_1:108.en:
$$甲児$$
「The biggest thing we got out of this trip is learning how the universe collapses.」

282:t_1:109.en:
$$アルト$$
「The clash between the force that tries to vanish and the force that tries to exist...」

282:t_1:110.en:
$n
「And the force that tries to vanish creates $$バアル$$ to snuff out the power of life...」

282:t_1:111.en:
$$甲児$$
「When I first heard about the universe collapsing, I had no idea how anyone could stop something like that, but...」

282:t_1:112.en:
$$甲児$$
「Basically, all we have to do is not lose to $$バアル$$, right? Now that we know how, it's a load off my mind.」

282:t_1:113.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yeah... I think that's how my world survived, since it managed to defeat $$バアル$$... the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

282:t_1:114.en:
$$ボス$$
「But hey... from what I heard, there's a collapse once every 120 million years that's even bigger than the 12,000-year one, right?」

282:t_1:115.en:
$$さやか$$
「So even more $$バアル$$ get born than in the 12,000-year collapse, after all...」

282:t_1:116.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Could be. In my world only $$宇宙怪獣$$ showed up, but...」

282:t_1:117.en:
$$ラルク$$
「In this world there aren't only the $$宇宙怪獣$$ $$ノリコ$$ fought, but also the type we fought.」

282:t_1:118.en:
$$レド$$
「On top of that, the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s, the $$バジュラ$$, and the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

282:t_1:119.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Wait, $$レド$$... The $$バジュラ$$ aren't $$バアル$$ or anything.」

282:t_1:120.en:
$$シェリル$$
「We can communicate with the $$バジュラ$$ in a way other than words, after all.」

282:t_1:121.en:
$$レド$$
「But the fact is, we've been fighting the $$バジュラ$$. This isn't a question of communication.」

282:t_1:122.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's just that we haven't established the means yet. If we can do that...」

282:t_1:123.en:
$$レド$$
「Naive. You must have learned in the battles in the galaxy that there's no room to consider the enemy's circumstances.」

282:t_1:124.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hold on, $$レド$$. Are you saying that if we can't communicate with someone, all we can do is fight?」

282:t_1:125.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then when we met on $$翠の地球$$, if some small misunderstanding had led to a fight, would we have had no choice but to kill each other?」

282:t_1:127.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Stop it, you two, $$レド$$ and $$アルト$$.」

282:t_1:128.en:
$$シェリル$$
「$$エイミー$$'s right. We can communicate, after all, so talk it out instead of picking a fight.」

282:t_1:130.en:
$$レド$$
「No... we were both at fault.」

282:t_1:131.en:
$$レド$$
「But when I met the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ again at the center of the galaxy, I remembered the Alliance's battles... how they killed so many of my comrades... hundreds of them, even...」

282:t_1:133.en:
$$レド$$
「If the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ attack, I don't intend to hesitate to fight.」

282:t_1:134.en:
$n
「Same here. If they come at us, I'll meet them with everything I've got.」

282:t_1:135.en:
$$甲児$$
「If talking can end the fighting, so much the better.」

282:t_1:136.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's right! Peace is the best, after all!」

282:t_1:137.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Come to think of it, $$レド$$... wasn't the center of the galaxy the area of operations of the $$人類銀河同盟$$ you belonged to?」

282:t_1:138.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Does that mean you made it back home?」

282:t_1:139.en:
$$レド$$
「...With one incident after another, I had no time to think about it.」

282:t_1:140.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「If we ever go to the center of the galaxy again, what will you do?」

282:t_1:144.en:
$$ボス$$
「Is that an enemy attack alarm...!?」

282:t_1:145.en:
$$さやか$$
「An enemy in a place like this... just as I feared...」

282:t_1:146.en:
$n
「Let's go too, if only to find out for sure.」

282:t_1:147.en:
$$チコ$$
「Huh...? Come to think of it, where's $$ニコラ$$?」

282:t_1:148.en:
$$ラルク$$
「He said he was sending the data on the $$宇宙怪獣$$ we met in the galaxy, and he's using the facilities here.」

282:t_1:150.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Wouldn't it be the $$宇宙軍$$?」

282:t_1:151.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Chatting's over. If it's $$バアル$$, we absolutely can't lose.」

282:t_1:152.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We're already inside the solar system... We're close to Earth, after all.」

282:t_2:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then we will now begin the briefing on our future actions.」

282:t_2:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「First, $$ティエリア$$... Please report on the Unknown we fought today.」

282:t_2:7.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I assume everyone has already experienced its threat firsthand, but I want to confirm the facts known at this point.」

282:t_2:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「First, for convenience, we will call that Unknown the 《$$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$》 from now on.」

282:t_2:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It's short for Extraterrestrial Living Metal Shapeshifter.」

282:t_2:12.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So, in short, they're weird metal life forms from space.」

282:t_2:13.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Where the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ came from, and for what purpose they flew into this solar system, is unknown.」

282:t_2:14.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「What matters is that they are fundamentally incapable of communication, and at the same time possess an extremely dangerous power.」
